statement.p: Find the volume of the pyramid with base in the plane z=-9 and sides formed by the three planes y=0 and y-x=2 and x+2y+z = 2.

static.solution:
The planes y=0, and y-x=2, and x+2y+z = 2 intersect the plane z = -9 in the lines y=0, y-x=2, x+2y = 11 on the z=-9 plane (think about looking straight down on the pyramid).
Let R be the triangle in the planes z=-9 with the above three points as vertices. Then, the volume of the solid is V = \int_0^{13/3}\int_{y-2}^{(11-2 y)}\int_{-9}^{2-x-2y}\,dz\,dx\,dy = \int_0^{13/3}\int_{y-2}^{(11-2 y)} 11-x-2y\,dx\,dy. Integrating with respect to x, we have V = \int_0^{13/3} \left((11 - 2 y)x - \frac12 x^2\right)\bigg|_{x=y-2}^{x=(11-2 y)}\,dy, so that V = \int_0^{13/3} (11 - 2 y)(13 - 3 y) - \frac12((11 - 2 y)^2 - (y-2)^2) \,dy. To evaluate this last integral we expand the squared terms and then proceed as expected, getting V = \frac{2197}{18}.
